info.title: Measles vaccination contact API
info.description: The data a measles vaccination contact (MEASLES.A) and its reporting (MEASLES.B) record: the core data elements MEASLES.DE.01-26.

get.summary: JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-MeaslesVaccinationContact
get.description: This endpoint serves the JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-MeaslesVaccinationContact.

StructureDefinition-MeaslesVaccinationCo.title: Measles vaccination contact
StructureDefinition-MeaslesVaccinationCo.description: The data a measles vaccination contact (MEASLES.A) and its reporting (MEASLES.B) record: the core data elements MEASLES.DE.01-26.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for MeaslesVaccinationContact logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for MeaslesVaccinationContact logical model

clientIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the client in the register or EIR (MEASLES.DE.01; used by MEASLES.A; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record)

dateOfBirth.description: Client's date of birth (MEASLES.DE.02; used by DT.01 DT.03 (age); rests on T1 measles footnote (ages throughout))

sex.description: Client's sex (MEASLES.DE.03; used by IND.01 IND.02 disaggregation; rests on JRF 4A. Routine Coverage)

caregiverName.description: Name of the caregiver who brings a child (MEASLES.DE.04; used by MEASLES.A; rests on catchup.multi-dose-return-date)

homeBasedRecordPresented.description: Whether a home-based record was presented at this contact (MEASLES.DE.05; used by MEASLES.A A1; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record)

nationalScheduleSetting.description: Whether the national schedule gives MCV1 at 9 months (high transmission) or 12 months (low transmission) (MEASLES.DE.06; used by DT.01 transmissionSetting; rests on measles.mcv1-9-months-high-transmission; measles.mcv1-12-months-low-transmission)

items.description: Coding-shaped {system, code} object from ValueSet MeaslesSupplementaryDoseIndicationVS

supplementaryDoseIndication.description: The infant is in a situation the measles footnote lists for a dose from 6 months (MEASLES.DE.07; used by DT.01 supplementaryIndication; rests on measles.mcv0-situations; measles.hiv-high-incidence-mcv0-6-months)

mcvDoseDateGiven.description: Date a measles-containing vaccine dose was given (MEASLES.DE.08; used by DT.03 DT.01; rests on measles.mcv0-recording)

mcvDoseDoseLabel.description: How the dose counts (MEASLES.DE.09; used by DT.03 countsAs; rests on measles.mcv0-recording; catchup.mcv2-only-after-mcv1)

mcvDoseVaccine.description: Which measles-containing vaccine was given (MEASLES.DE.10; used by IND.01 IND.02; rests on JRF 2A. Schedule rows 2270-2310; measles.same-formulation-both-doses)

mcvDoseDocumented.description: Whether the dose is documented in a home-based record or register (MEASLES.DE.11; used by DT.03 documented; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record; catchup.unconfirmed-assume-unvaccinated)

anaphylaxisOrSevereAllergyToAVaccineComp.description: History of anaphylaxis or severe allergic reaction to any component (e.g. neomycin or gelatin) (MEASLES.DE.12; used by DT.02; rests on measles.contraindications)

severeImmunosuppression.description: Client has any form of severe immunosuppression (MEASLES.DE.13; used by DT.02; rests on measles.contraindications)

pregnant.description: Client is pregnant (MEASLES.DE.14; used by DT.02; rests on measles.avoid-in-pregnancy)

mildConcurrentInfection.description: Client has a mild concurrent infection (recorded; not a reason to defer) (MEASLES.DE.15; used by DT.02; rests on measles.mild-infection-not-contraindication)

dateOfLastOtherLiveVaccine.description: Date another live vaccine (not OPV) was last given (MEASLES.DE.16; used by DT.02 weeksSinceOtherLiveVaccine; rests on measles.live-vaccine-spacing; catchup.live-vaccine-spacing)

hivStatus.description: Client's HIV status (MEASLES.DE.17; used by DT.01 DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-routine-vaccination; measles.hiv-exposed-mcv0)

receivingHaart.description: Client is receiving highly active antiretroviral therapy (MEASLES.DE.18; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)

haartStartDate.description: Date HAART was started (MEASLES.DE.19; used by DT.04 monthsSinceHaartStart; rests on measles.hiv-haart-no-cd4-monitoring)

cd4TLymphocytePercentage.description: Most recent CD4+ T lymphocyte count as a percentage (MEASLES.DE.20; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)

hivAdditionalMcvDoseGiven.description: The additional dose after immune reconstitution has been given (MEASLES.DE.21; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)

screeningOutcome.description: Outcome of screening before vaccination (MEASLES.DE.22; used by MEASLES.A G2; rests on DT.02)

reasonNotVaccinated.description: Why no dose was given at this contact (MEASLES.DE.23; used by MEASLES.A A9; rests on measles.avoid-in-pregnancy; measles.contraindications; measles.live-vaccine-spacing)

nextMcvDueDate.description: Date the next MCV dose is due (MEASLES.DE.24; used by MEASLES.A A7 A9; MEASLES.B B1; rests on catchup.multi-dose-return-date)

healthWorkerMeaslesImmunityProof.description: Proof or documentation of measles immunity or immunization for a health worker (MEASLES.DE.25; used by MEASLES.S4; rests on measles.health-worker-immunity)

confirmedMeaslesCase.description: A confirmed measles case (laboratory or epidemiological link; reported clinical cases included as the JRF instructs) (MEASLES.DE.26; used by IND.07; rests on JRF 1. Reported Cases row 1020; Instructions row 10)
